title: Regular set is open and dense (Simon 5.7.3)
statement: If n >= 1, U is open, V = v(M,theta) has generalized mean curvature H in U with H locally in L^p(mu_V), p > n, and theta is a positive integer for mu_V-a.e. x in spt V, then there is an open O with reg V = O cap spt V, and spt V = closure(reg V) cap U, where reg V is the set of xi in spt V such that open B_rho(xi) cap spt V is an n-dimensional C^1 submanifold (IsC1Submanifold n) for some rho > 0.
